captions.detailed: An all-in-one printer featuring a light gray body, a dark gray automatic document feeder (ADF) lid, and a front-loading paper cassette. A small control panel on the right side contains five dark blue buttons and a central selector dial. The flatbed scanner lid, the ADF lid, the front paper cassette, and the front multipurpose tray flap are designed to articulate via standard rotational and prismatic joints.
captions.instruction: Create a 3D model of a compact office all-in-one printer with an articulating flatbed scanner lid, a top automatic document feeder lid, a sliding front paper cassette, and a hinged multipurpose tray flap.
captions.factory: Construct the main body using a boolean-subtracted Box to create a hollow central cavity and front slot. Model the control panel using a raised platform, five small box primitives for buttons, and a cylinder for the dial. Form the scanner lid, ADF lid, front cassette, and multipurpose flap using box and hollow slot geometries, then define revolute and prismatic joints to enable realistic movement.
